drivingQuestion: Does the mishna imply Akko is overseas, against Rav Safra's report?
outcomeNote: the answer (Abaye) arrives in the next unit

segments.he: ״הֲרֵי זֶה גִּיטִּיךְ אִם לֹא בָּאתִי מִכָּאן וְעַד שְׁלֹשִׁים יוֹם״ כּוּ׳: לְמֵימְרָא דְּעַכּוֹ בִּמְדִינַת הַיָּם קָיְימָא?! וְהָא אָמַר רַב סָפְרָא: כִּי הֲווֹ מִיפַּטְרִי רַבָּנַן מֵהֲדָדֵי – בְּעַכּוֹ הֲווֹ מִפַּטְרִי, מִשּׁוּם דְּאָסוּר לָצֵאת מֵאָרֶץ לְחוּצָה לָאָרֶץ!
segments.en: The continuation of the mishna taught: «This is your bill of divorce if I do not come» back «from now until» the conclusion of «thirty days.» The Gemara asks: «Is this to say that Akko is in a country overseas,» and is not considered part of Eretz Yisrael? «But didn’t Rav Safra say: When the Sages would take leave from one another» before departing Eretz Yisrael, «they would take» their «leave in Akko, because it is prohibited to leave from Eretz Yisrael to» go «outside of Eretz» Yisrael? This indicates that Akko is within Eretz Yisrael.

moves.summary: the mishna seems to put Akko overseas, against Rav Safra
moves.about: the mishna implies Akko is overseas; Rav Safra's report implies it is in Eretz Yisrael

edges.cueHe: למימרא דעכו במדינת הים קיימא?! והא אמר רב ספרא
edges.about: the mishna implies Akko is overseas; Rav Safra's report implies it is in Eretz Yisrael
Sages took leave of one another in Akko

edges.cueHe: כי הוו מיפטרי רבנן מהדדי – בעכו הוו מפטרי
edges.about: Sages parted in Akko because it is forbidden to leave the Land

positions.claim: Sages took leave of each other at Akko since leaving the Land is forbidden, so Akko is in the Land

extras.about: Sages took leave of one another in Akko
